teaches: A trait entry stores the printed token and the number twice: `value` is what the sheet prints, `num` is what every rule reads.
`range.band` and `range.value` are two readings of one distance and both are stored.
`damageType` is what an armour or a creature answers with — it selects the damage-response reading.
demo.trap: `params[].num` is filled in here because `refreshTraitNumbers()` runs on sheet submit only. An `AP (3)` left at `num: null` scores 0 and nothing says so.
